title: Prefer the system-provided edit menu

statement.en: Prefer the system-provided edit menu for standard editing commands.
statement.ja: 標準editing commandにはsystem-provided edit menuを優先する。

conditions: Avoid recreating the same standard commands in a custom menu because duplication can confuse people.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Edit menus experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるEdit menusの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

title: Use familiar system interactions to reveal edit menus

statement.ja: 各platformで慣れたsystem-defined interactionを使ってedit menuを表示できるようにする。

conditions: Support the applicable touch-and-hold, pinch-and-hold, and secondary-click conventions instead of introducing a custom interaction for a standard task.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Edit menus experience on the scoped Apple platforms.

title: Keep edit-menu commands relevant to the current state

statement.en: Show edit-menu commands relevant to the current state, removing or dimming commands that don't apply.
statement.ja: 現在のstateに関連するedit-menu commandを表示し、適用できないcommandは削除またはdim表示する。

conditions: When nothing is selected, omit or disable commands such as Copy or Cut that require a selection.
When there is nothing to paste, omit or disable Paste.

title: Reposition edit menus only when necessary

statement.en: Reposition an iOS or iPadOS edit menu when necessary to keep important content visible.
statement.ja: 重要なcontentを見える状態に保つ必要がある場合はiOSまたはiPadOSのedit menuを再配置する。

conditions: Keep the default placement above or below the insertion point or selection when it works.
Move the menu when it would otherwise cover important content or interface areas.
The menu position can change, but its shape and pointer cannot.
